hypothesis: Freeze a task-agnostic, variance-conditioned probabilistic SMILES autoencoder trained only on the unlabeled corpus, then optimize each objective with one persistent full-covariance CMA-ES distribution initialized at the best fixed observation: draw fresh latent points directly from the evolving Gaussian, decode them de novo, and use returned oracle-score ranks to adapt its mean, covariance, and global step size so repeatedly favorable coordinated latent directions receive more proposal probability.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic MolMIM-style probabilistic SMILES autoencoder only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, using variance-conditioned latent training so local perturbations remain decodable, and then freeze it. In each independent objective session, encode the fixed evaluated starting molecules, center a CMA-ES search distribution on the best observed latent, and repeat an ask/tell loop: sample a fresh latent population from the current multivariate Gaussian, decode each point de novo, canonicalize and locally replace invalid or previously seen molecules, submit only the newly decoded batch, and update the Gaussian mean, covariance, and global step size from the returned score ranks. The method neither fits a surrogate nor screens the corpus; oracle feedback changes the continuous proposal distribution directly, so coordinated latent directions that repeatedly yield better molecules receive more probability during the 290 adaptive calls. The sole success target is the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline unlabeled dense-latent autoencoder training plus online rank-weighted adaptation of Gaussian mean, covariance, and step size
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: CMA-ES ask/tell sampling from a rank-adapted multivariate Gaussian followed by de novo SMILES decoding
method_tags.representation: fixed-length continuous SMILES codes from a corpus-trained variance-conditioned probabilistic autoencoder

activation_observables.measurement: On a fixed held-out corpus sample during preparation, encode each sequence and decode both its posterior-mean code and seeded samples at every declared latent-variance condition; report canonical reconstruction at the mean and the valid canonical decode fraction at each nonzero condition, with tokenization, completion, invalidity, and canonicalization failures retained in the denominators relative to a zero-success baseline.
activation_observables.name: variance_conditioned_latent_decode_stability

activation_observables.measurement: For every emitted canonical molecule, record its CMA generation and sample identifier, sampled standard-normal vector, transformed latent point, contemporaneous mean, covariance factor and global step size, and frozen-decoder output; report the fraction reproducibly traceable to a fresh draw from the current Gaussian and a de novo decode, relative to a zero-trace baseline.
activation_observables.name: direct_cma_latent_decode_trace_rate

activation_observables.measurement: For every tell update with non-tied accepted scores, report the positive-recombination-weighted mean normalized score-rank percentile minus the uniform-weight expectation, and verify that the realized mean displacement equals the recorded rank-weighted latent displacement under the CMA learning rule; aggregate the signed rank advantage across updates.
activation_observables.name: rank_weighted_cma_mean_pressure

activation_observables.measurement: After each tell update, record the evolution-path norms, rank-one and rank-mu covariance contributions, covariance Frobenius change, minimum and maximum eigenvalues, global step size, and signed log step-size change; report the fraction of feedback updates with finite nonzero covariance or step-size movement from their immediately preceding states.
activation_observables.name: covariance_and_step_size_adaptation_activity

activation_observables.measurement: After every observe message, report the fraction of accepted scored molecules matched exactly once to their emitted CMA sample identifiers and included exactly once in that generation's score-ranked tell update, together with unmatched, multiply matched, rejected, and update-eligible counts.
activation_observables.name: oracle_feedback_tell_coverage

activation_observables.measurement: For every suggestion round, report unique valid canonical molecules emitted per fresh CMA latent draw, with separate counts for decoder non-completion, invalid molecules, already evaluated molecules, prior emissions, and within-round collisions, and verify that the emitted list equals the batch size announced by init.
activation_observables.name: novel_valid_cma_decode_yield

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus is sufficient to train a variance-conditioned dense latent representation whose frozen decoder reconstructs and locally perturbs SMILES with useful valid-molecule yield.
The fixed initial molecules can be encoded and provide at least one viable center from which the decoder-supported latent region contains novel structures.
Oracle scores exhibit enough rank variation across feedback batches for rank-weighted recombination and evolution paths to distinguish favorable latent displacements.

Useful high-scoring chemistry is reachable through coordinated changes represented by the evolving single-Gaussian mean and covariance rather than requiring a disconnected mode outside decoder support.
Latent decoding, canonicalization, and resampling maintain enough novel-valid yield to fill every protocol-announced batch before the evaluator's 3000-proposal safety limit.

The chosen latent dimension permits stable full-covariance estimation and adaptation within 29 feedback rounds and the supplied compute profile; the method may underperform when rewards are effectively tied or highly discontinuous, the useful region is strongly multimodal, or the frozen decoder omits decisive chemistry.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if prepared latent samples do not support valid molecular decoding, if emitted proposals cannot be traced directly to fresh samples from the persistent CMA Gaussian, or if accepted score ranks fail to produce reproducible nonzero mean pressure and finite covariance or step-size adaptation before the subsequent suggestion rounds.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to learn and publish the SMILES vocabulary, configuration, and weights of a dense-latent probabilistic autoencoder whose decoder is trained on variance-conditioned latent samples from the unlabeled corpus. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load and freeze the autoencoder on logical cuda:0, encode the fixed initial molecules, initialize a task-local full-covariance CMA-ES state at the highest-scoring initial code, and fill every evaluator-announced batch by directly sampling the current Gaussian, decoding each point de novo, canonicalizing it, and resampling after invalid, already evaluated, previously emitted, or within-batch duplicate outcomes. Retain the exact latent provenance of every emission and, after each observe message, pair accepted scores with those points and perform the standard rank-weighted CMA-ES mean, evolution-path, rank-one/rank-mu covariance, and cumulative step-size updates without fitting a surrogate or pre-ranking an overgenerated molecular pool.
research_intent.mechanism: Freeze a task-agnostic, variance-conditioned probabilistic SMILES autoencoder trained only on the unlabeled corpus, then optimize each objective with one persistent full-covariance CMA-ES distribution initialized at the best fixed observation: draw fresh latent points directly from the evolving Gaussian, decode them de novo, and use returned oracle-score ranks to adapt its mean, covariance, and global step size so repeatedly favorable coordinated latent directions receive more proposal probability.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, so a surrogate-free latent optimizer has just 29 feedback rounds in which to discover coordinated molecular directions; a poorly structured latent space, rank-insensitive distribution updates, or invalid and duplicate decodes can exhaust that opportunity without moving probability toward better molecules.

applicability_conditions: Supported on this corpus and preparation configuration: 199,616 examples trained the 32-dimensional variance-conditioned autoencoder, and held-out nonzero-variance decoding produced 385 valid canonical molecules from 1,152 samples. Posterior-mean exact canonical reconstruction was only 30/384, so evidence supports decodable local structure more strongly than faithful reconstruction.

Supported when the fixed initial panel is representable: all 10 initial molecules in each of five sessions encoded successfully, every logged initial OOV-token count was zero, and each session initialized its Gaussian at the highest-scoring initial code.

Supported when feedback batches have usable rank variation: all 145 updates had non-tied scores and positive signed rank advantage, allowing every accepted batch to move the mean and both adaptation state variables.

Supported for the evaluated seed-0 objectives under one evolving Gaussian: terminal Top-1 exceeded initial Top-1 on each of the five tasks, while all 140 intermediate tell states were carried into the subsequent asks. This does not establish reachability for disconnected or strongly multimodal reward regions outside frozen-decoder support.

Supported under batch size 10 and this resampling cap despite modest decoder yield: pooled novel-valid yield was 0.15658747300215983, the worst round still filled after 191 draws, and all 145 announced batches were complete. Applicability is weaker when valid yield falls below what can fill a batch within 2,048 local draws.

Supported for stable 32-dimensional full-covariance adaptation over 29 rounds in the supplied compute profile: every covariance remained positive definite over the logged extrema and every task completed its budget. Evidence is limited to screening seed 0 and does not establish multi-seed stability, behavior under effectively tied rewards, or transfer beyond this corpus and frozen decoder.

activation_observables.measurement: For every emitted canonical molecule, record its CMA generation and sample identifier, sampled standard-normal vector, transformed latent point, contemporaneous mean, covariance factor and global step size, and frozen-decoder output; report the fraction reproducibly traceable to a fresh draw from the current Gaussian and a de novo decode, relative to a zero-trace baseline.
activation_observables.name: direct_cma_latent_decode_trace_rate

activation_observables.measurement: For every tell update with non-tied accepted scores, report the positive-recombination-weighted mean normalized score-rank percentile minus the uniform-weight expectation, and verify that the realized mean displacement equals the recorded rank-weighted latent displacement under the CMA learning rule; aggregate the signed rank advantage across updates.
activation_observables.name: rank_weighted_cma_mean_pressure

activation_observables.measurement: After each tell update, record the evolution-path norms, rank-one and rank-mu covariance contributions, covariance Frobenius change, minimum and maximum eigenvalues, global step size, and signed log step-size change; report the fraction of feedback updates with finite nonzero covariance or step-size movement from their immediately preceding states.
activation_observables.name: covariance_and_step_size_adaptation_activity

activation_observables.measurement: After every observe message, report the fraction of accepted scored molecules matched exactly once to their emitted CMA sample identifiers and included exactly once in that generation's score-ranked tell update, together with unmatched, multiply matched, rejected, and update-eligible counts.
activation_observables.name: oracle_feedback_tell_coverage

activation_observables.measurement: For every suggestion round, report unique valid canonical molecules emitted per fresh CMA latent draw, with separate counts for decoder non-completion, invalid molecules, already evaluated molecules, prior emissions, and within-round collisions, and verify that the emitted list equals the batch size announced by init.
activation_observables.name: novel_valid_cma_decode_yield

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus is sufficient to train a variance-conditioned dense latent representation whose frozen decoder reconstructs and locally perturbs SMILES with useful valid-molecule yield.
The fixed initial molecules can be encoded and provide at least one viable center from which the decoder-supported latent region contains novel structures.
Oracle scores exhibit enough rank variation across feedback batches for rank-weighted recombination and evolution paths to distinguish favorable latent displacements.

Useful high-scoring chemistry is reachable through coordinated changes represented by the evolving single-Gaussian mean and covariance rather than requiring a disconnected mode outside decoder support.
Latent decoding, canonicalization, and resampling maintain enough novel-valid yield to fill every protocol-announced batch before the evaluator's 3000-proposal safety limit.

The chosen latent dimension permits stable full-covariance estimation and adaptation within 29 feedback rounds and the supplied compute profile; the method may underperform when rewards are effectively tied or highly discontinuous, the useful region is strongly multimodal, or the frozen decoder omits decisive chemistry.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if prepared latent samples do not support valid molecular decoding, if emitted proposals cannot be traced directly to fresh samples from the persistent CMA Gaussian, or if accepted score ranks fail to produce reproducible nonzero mean pressure and finite covariance or step-size adaptation before the subsequent suggestion rounds.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to learn and publish the SMILES vocabulary, configuration, and weights of a dense-latent probabilistic autoencoder whose decoder is trained on variance-conditioned latent samples from the unlabeled corpus. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load and freeze the autoencoder on logical cuda:0, encode the fixed initial molecules, initialize a task-local full-covariance CMA-ES state at the highest-scoring initial code, and fill every evaluator-announced batch by directly sampling the current Gaussian, decoding each point de novo, canonicalizing it, and resampling after invalid, already evaluated, previously emitted, or within-batch duplicate outcomes. Retain the exact latent provenance of every emission and, after each observe message, pair accepted scores with those points and perform the standard rank-weighted CMA-ES mean, evolution-path, rank-one/rank-mu covariance, and cumulative step-size updates without fitting a surrogate or pre-ranking an overgenerated molecular pool.
research_intent.mechanism: Freeze a task-agnostic, variance-conditioned probabilistic SMILES autoencoder trained only on the unlabeled corpus, then optimize each objective with one persistent full-covariance CMA-ES distribution initialized at the best fixed observation: draw fresh latent points directly from the evolving Gaussian, decode them de novo, and use returned oracle-score ranks to adapt its mean, covariance, and global step size so repeatedly favorable coordinated latent directions receive more proposal probability.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, so a surrogate-free latent optimizer has just 29 feedback rounds in which to discover coordinated molecular directions; a poorly structured latent space, rank-insensitive distribution updates, or invalid and duplicate decodes can exhaust that opportunity without moving probability toward better molecules.
